Case: No horizontal scroll and full form card is visible at 1024 px viewport width on the login page
Description:
• Pre-condition: Browser set to 1024 px viewport width. Auth pages are deployed. Prerequisite sleekflow-login-signup-000 is complete.
  • Source: sleekflow-login-signup-010 · AC1
  • AC Quote: At 1001, 1024, 1100, 1200 and 1280 px, the page has no horizontal scroll and the whole form card is visible.
Test Steps:
1. Open the browser and set viewport width to 1024 px (height can be any standard value, e.g. 768 px).
  2. Navigate to the SleekFlow login identifier page.
  3. Observe whether a horizontal scrollbar appears.
  4. Observe whether the entire form card (all fields and buttons) is visible without being cut off.
Expected:
• No horizontal scrollbar is present.
  • The full form card is visible — no fields, labels, or buttons are clipped or hidden beyond the viewport edge.
BDD: Given the login page at 1024 px viewport width, When the page is loaded, Then no horizontal scroll exists and the full form card is visible.

Case: No horizontal scroll appears across all five specified breakpoints on all auth pages
Description:
• Pre-condition: All auth pages accessible: login identifier, login password, sign-up identifier, sign-up password, reset password. Viewports to test: 1001, 1024, 1100, 1200, 1280 px.
  • Source: sleekflow-login-signup-010 · AC1, AC3
  • AC Quote: At 1001, 1024, 1100, 1200 and 1280 px, the page has no horizontal scroll and the whole form card is visible. Affects ALL auth pages.
Test Steps:
1. For each viewport width [1001, 1024, 1100, 1200, 1280 px], repeat steps 2–5.
  2. Set browser viewport width to the target value.
  3. Visit each auth page: login identifier, login password, sign-up identifier, sign-up password, reset password.
  4. Observe whether a horizontal scrollbar appears on each page.
  5. Observe whether the form card is fully visible on each page.
Expected:
• At every listed viewport width and on every auth page, no horizontal scrollbar is present.
  • The full form card is visible and not clipped at any tested width.
BDD: Given all auth pages at viewport widths 1001–1280 px, When each page is loaded at each specified width, Then no horizontal scroll is present and form cards are fully visible.

  • Source: sleekflow-login-signup-010 · AC2
  • AC Quote: ≤ 1000 px: one column, marketing panel below or hidden. (UX-04)
Test Steps:
1. Set browser viewport width to 1000 px.
  2. Navigate to the SleekFlow login page.
  3. Observe the layout: check whether the form is in a single column and the marketing panel position.
  4. Repeat at 768 px viewport width.
Expected:
• At 1000 px: single-column layout is displayed; the marketing panel is either positioned below the form or not visible.
  • At 768 px: same single-column behaviour.
  • No horizontal scroll at either width.
BDD: Given the login page at 1000 px or less viewport width, When the page is loaded, Then a single-column layout is displayed with the marketing panel below or hidden.
